title: factory-path-lease-policy
description: Versioned strict generic path-lease policy configuration (Phase 2C1). The trusted lease authority (.factory/loop/path_lease.py) maps closed scope IDs to bounded repository-relative path prefixes/patterns for product-owned verification surfaces (scripts, build environment/Nix files, packaging, CI/forge files) and declares absolute immutable deny zones (.factory security/control machinery, .factory-state, .git, credential/key/env authorities, the product spec path, and all goldens/approval/release/human-authority surfaces as configured). Deny is dominant and non-overridable: a requested scope's paths inside a deny zone are removed, a scope that grants nothing after expansion is forbidden, and no carve-out exists in this schema (a human-only override mechanism is deliberately out of scope and must never be mintable by a campaign/model). The field set is closed (additionalProperties false), duplicate JSON keys are rejected at parse time, paths reject absolute/traversal/backslash/control/glob characters, grant patterns reject `**` recursive traversal as symlink-ambiguous (deny patterns may use `**` conservatively), and overlapping deny escapes are rejected at load. Claims minted from this policy are DATA bound to campaign/task/attempt/commit/plan/policy digests and are never self-authorizing.

items.description: A repository-relative exact path prefix (no leading slash, no empty/`.`/`..` segment, no backslash/control/glob character).

paths.description: Exact repository-relative path prefixes granted by this scope.

items.description: A bounded repository-relative glob pattern. Segments are literal or glob (`*`, `?`, `[...]` classes over the safe character set); `**` is rejected as symlink-ambiguous recursive traversal in grant patterns.

patterns.description: Bounded glob patterns granted by this scope (no `**`).

audit_required.description: When true, a lease granting this scope is security-sensitive and marks independent audit required.

scopes.description: Closed scope-ID map. Scope IDs match `^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*$` and are unique (JSON duplicate keys are rejected).

paths.description: Absolute immutable deny-zone path prefixes (.factory, .factory-state, .git, credential/key/env authorities, the product spec path, and all goldens/approval/release/human-authority surfaces as configured). Deny zones are non-overridable: no carve-out exists in this schema.

items.description: Deny patterns may use `**` conservatively: over-matching deny only removes grants.

patterns.description: Deny patterns matched against concrete paths at expansion/enforcement time.
